drivingQuestion: What is the source that divorce and the husband's death free a wife to remarry?
outcomeNote: the בשלמא half only; the question about the husband's death continues in sugya038

segments.he: וְקוֹנָה אֶת עַצְמָהּ בְּגֵט וּבְמִיתַת הַבַּעַל. בִּשְׁלָמָא גֵּט, דִּכְתִיב: ״וְכָתַב לָהּ סֵפֶר כְּרִיתֻת״.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: «And» a woman «acquires herself through a bill of divorce or through the death of the husband.» The Gemara asks: «Granted,» this is the halakha with regard to «a bill of divorce, as it is written» explicitly in the Torah: «“And he writes for her a scroll of severance,» and gives it in her hand, and sends her out of his house; and she departs out of his house and she goes and becomes another man’s wife” (Deuteronomy 24:1–2). This indicates that a bill of divorce enables a woman to marry whomever she wishes after the divorce.
